backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and workout logs with access-control checks and CRUD operations for logs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing image‑related frontend update requirements and associated components/tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files describing their roles in the training planner app.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global frontend CSS.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component composing all main sections and wiring identity and workout log data into the schedule.
frontend/src/components/training-planner: Exercise library UI showing muscle groups with accordion‑based lists of top exercises and form cues.
Footer displaying copyright text and a Caffeine.ai attribution link with tracking parameters.
Sticky header with navigation and a profile image that falls back to a logo on load error.
Renders the landing hero with certifications, marketing text, CTA buttons, metrics, and a hero image. Includes smooth scrolling and WhatsApp chat initiation.
Provides a hydration calculator and reminder system based on weight, activity level, and interval settings. Uses in‑app reminders and toast notifications for hydration prompts.
Displays nutrition principles and recipe cards using data-driven content. Includes accordions for recipe details and structured nutrition guidance.
Shows a professional bio with image fallback, credentials, and background details. Includes badges, experience info, and WhatsApp contact CTA.
Allows authenticated users to log, view, and delete workout entries. Integrates identity login, workout log mutations, sorting, and form inputs for recording sessions.
Implements BMI and ideal weight calculators with input validation and result display. Uses tabs for tool switching and toast errors for invalid input.
Renders a 7‑day training schedule with selectable days and completion tracking based on workout logs. Uses UI components and memoized logic to show progress and rest days.
frontend/src/content/exerciseLibraryData: Provides structured exercise library data grouped by muscle group, including names, descriptions, and form cues. Used to populate exercise listings in the UI.
Contains nutrition principles and recipe data with macros, ingredients, and instructions. Supplies static content for the nutrition guide section.
frontend/src/content/trainingPlannerCopy: Exports detailed descriptive copy for each day of the weekly training plan. Includes focus areas, descriptions, and tips for all seven days.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes. Handles admin token initialization and anonymous fallback.
frontend/src/hooks/useInAppReminder.ts: Implements a timer‑based reminder hook that triggers callbacks at a specified interval. Provides start/stop controls and manages interval cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context with login, logout, and status tracking using Dfinity AuthClient. Loads stored identities, manages authentication state, and exposes identity to consumers.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkoutLogs.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and deleting workout logs using the backend actor with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/healthCalculators.ts: Provides BMI calculation and ideal weight range utilities based on height and gender.
frontend/src/utils/hydration.ts: Calculates recommended daily water intake in liters and cups based on weight and activity level.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Generates a WhatsApp chat link and provides a function to open it using a normalized trainer phone number.
frontend/src/utils/workoutLogMapping.ts: Maps weekdays between labels and enums and formats workout timestamps and durations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, images, and architectural notes for the Training Planner site.
